title: Retry a Command with Backoff
description: Retries a command via Ansible's native until/retries/delay -- the idiomatic replacement for a hand-written retry loop. Ansible's retry only supports a fixed delay between attempts (no native exponential backoff), unlike the bash/python versions of this template.

variables.name: COMMAND_DESCRIPTION
variables.prompt: One-line description of the command being retried (used as the task name)

variables.name: COMMAND_TO_RUN
variables.prompt: The exact command to run (quote it exactly as you would type it yourself)

variables.name: DELAY_SECONDS
variables.prompt: Fixed delay between attempts, in seconds
